source.authority: Two user-provided Telegram iPhone screenshots in this conversation; V4 Classic/Tinted pairing rejected.
source.sampling: ICC conversion before pixel analysis; dominant opaque bubble colors and median wallpaper patches. Values are screenshot samples, not official universal theme tokens.

dark.outgoingRule: One vertical gradient field spanning first through last outgoing bubble, clipped into each bubble; not restarted per bubble.

light.wallpaper: Static CSS multi-point gradient approximating sampled anchors, with low-contrast official line-art mask.

dark.pattern: Static violet/brown/blue mask on black, no native shader or glass.

notes: Header and composer use opaque representative screenshot colors instead of native Liquid Glass.
Settings examples extend the screenshot palette; the screenshots do not establish actual Telegram settings colors.
Fictional two-person messages only; no screenshot message text, links, names, status bar or group UI saved.
Sampling preserves screenshot color relationships; spatial wallpaper and line-art placement are approximations, not pixel-perfect reconstruction.

pattern.renderArgument: absolute local path to retrieved passive SVG

evidence: Static visual direction only; no interactive prototype, Safari keyboard validation, product implementation, CI or production release.
